empty-state.name: Empty State
empty-state.purpose: Explain an empty surface and provide context, recovery, or next action when useful content is absent.

anatomy.rule: Centers message inside the owning surface.

variants.description: Filters or search returned no results.
The surface could not load or recover.

empty-state.statePrecedence: error > loading > permission > action > search-empty > default

Energy.decision: Use muted surfaces and semantic action colors.
Energy.behavior: Absence is clear without visual noise.
Energy.test: Verify contrast for text and action.
Energy.rejectIf: Raw colors define icon or action.

Voice.behavior: User understands why content is missing.

Frame.decision: Use centered column, 64px icon circle, gap, padding, and max copy width.
Frame.rejectIf: Message becomes a page hero inside a panel.

Depth.decision: Use owning surface depth; empty state does not add another card.
Depth.rejectIf: Empty state floats as unrelated card.

Momentum.decision: Use subtle action feedback only; absence does not need decorative motion.

State.decision: Resolve error and loading before generic absence.
State.rejectIf: Error is shown as generic empty.

Tone.decision: Use tone only when absence is risk, permission, or error.

Growth.decision: Escalate repeated empty states to onboarding, filters, or data setup patterns.
Growth.test: Verify next action exists when needed.

Symbol.decision: Use icons as support, not meaning source.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon size inside a 64px circle.

Accessibility.decision: Use visible text, real actions, and no decorative icon announcement.
Accessibility.behavior: Assistive tech users understand absence and recovery.
Accessibility.test: Verify button name and icon aria-hidden.

props.name: action
props.notes: Single local recovery action rendered with Button.

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Allows the message to fill the owning empty surface.

props.name: onAction
props.notes: Called when the recovery action is selected.

do: Offer one recovery action when available.
dont: Do not replace loading or detailed errors.
info: Use Inline Validation or Toast for recent user actions.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: full surface with readable max width

agentInstructions: Use Empty State for recoverable absence.
Ask when absence may be permission, outage, loading, or error.
Define title, description, icon, state, and real recovery action.
